concerns.text: FR-003 and SC-001 require discarding the bottom [deferred] (percentile-based) of videos. T016 and T007b explicitly hardcode a fixed absolute score threshold (60.0) and forbid dynamic percentile calculation. No task exists to implement the percentile-based filtering logic required by the spec.

FR-005 and SC-003 require evaluating against the PhysisForcing baseline. T033a-1 attempts to fetch this from an external source with a hard abort on failure. No task exists to handle the scenario where the fetch fails (e.g., using a local cached baseline or a defined fallback strategy) to ensure SC-003 remains measurable.

FR-002 requires a 'lightweight' CPU-based physics filter. T015b implements 'Video-to-Simulation Reconstruction' using optical flow and object detection (heavy CV dependencies). No task exists to implement a lightweight, direct physics scoring method that avoids these heavy CV dependencies as implied by the spec's constraints.

SC-005 requires measuring training time against a 'predefined time limit'. T025 hardcodes the limit to 'maximum 3 epochs' to guarantee completion. No task exists to measure the actual wall-clock time against an external, fixed time target (e.g., 4 hours) to verify SC-005 independently.

FR-005 requires evaluation against an 'unfiltered baseline'. T017 trains a 'Randomized Control Model' on raw data. No task explicitly traces to or defines the creation of the specific 'unfiltered baseline' model state required for the comparison, creating ambiguity in the comparison target.

FR-009 mandates augmentation only if retained count < 30. T034 samples from the 'augmented curated dataset' if augmentation occurred. No task exists to verify that the statistical power assumptions of the TOST test (FR-006) are not violated by the artificial inflation of the evaluation set size via augmentation.

SC-003 requires a formal TOST equivalence test (p-value < 0.05). T049 performs a 'descriptive comparison' against the paper report. No task exists to perform the formal TOST statistical verification step if the primary TOST (T035a) fails or is skipped, leaving SC-003 unverified.
